description: Expiring baseline for no-irreversible-data-loss gaps that existed when ADR 0040 introduced baseline-plus-blocking rollout.

entries.reason: Provider runtimes expose many delete/archive operations; this slice classifies the control-plane policy and blocks growth but does not backfill every provider operation with a provider-specific restore receipt.
entries.repair: Add per-provider recovery metadata for generated hard-delete operations and require provider receipt fixtures for supported live execution.

entries.reason: ADR 0001 and evolution docs require versioned import/export/backup/snapshot formats, but this slice does not enumerate every existing format in one transaction.
entries.repair: Add a generated inventory of import/export/backup/snapshot formats and attach recovery policy refs to each stable format.

entries.reason: The Constitution defines budgets and reversible self-modification, but existing agent action registries are not fully backfilled with no-data-loss policy ids in this first guardrail slice.
entries.repair: Attach explicit recovery policy refs and irreversible-action budget fields to agent action registries and inspect output.
